testcase.name: Scenario: Import settings while another command is staged on the same target: tmp/oblikovati-ribbon-relocated.RcZVDl/pinned-checkout/features/application/ribbon-customization/ribbon-customization.feature:1341:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Import settings while another command is staged on the same target ✔ Given a part is active in the MCAD Software with the full Tools ribbon visible ✔ And ribbon customization shows 2D Sketches applied to the Part Tools target ✔ And a settings file contains 2D Sketches on Part Tools with Large and Text unchecked ✔ And 3D Annotations is staged after 2D Sketches on Part Tools but has not been applied ✔ When the user imports the settings file ✔ Then the import chooser closes ✔ And the Part Tools target shows only 2D Sketches with Large and Text unchecked ✔ And 3D Annotations is available in the source list ✔ And the Part Tools target shows a pending-change marker ✔ And Apply and cancels are available ✔ When the user clicks Cancel in the customization dialog ✔ Then the customization dialog closes ✔ And the Tools ribbon remains visible
